mapper.delete: delete from ww_task_lean where job_id in (select job_id from ww_job where product=#{product})
mapper.select: select * from ww_task_lean where job_id = #{jobId} and (lean_job_id is null or lean_job_id=job_id)

select l.job_id,l.lean_task_id||'.'||s.task_plugin source,l.task_id||'.'||t.task_plugin target,'{"type":"s:e","lineType":"1"}' data from ww_task_lean l,ww_task s,ww_task t where l.job_id = s.job_id and l.lean_task_id=s.task_id and l.job_id = t.job_id and l.task_id=t.task_id
and l.job_id = #{jobId}

select l.job_id,concat(l.lean_task_id,'.',s.task_plugin) source,concat(l.task_id,'.',t.task_plugin) target,'{"type":"s:e","lineType":"1"}' data from ww_task_lean l,ww_task s,ww_task t where l.job_id = s.job_id and l.lean_task_id=s.task_id and l.job_id = t.job_id and l.task_id=t.task_id
and l.job_id = #{jobId}
